subject.title: Feature: Support custom anthropic_beta flags in Bedrock model config

question: Should Bedrock expose a broad `additionalModelRequestFields` or `providerFields` merge contract, a narrower typed `anthropicBeta` or `context1m` option, or keep Anthropic beta flags internal?
rationale: The missing path is source-proven, but adding request-body config expands a public provider contract and repository policy sets a high bar for new config surfaces.

options.title: Add Bedrock request-field merge contract
options.body: Expose a Bedrock-owned, schema-validated merge point for vendor request fields and document precedence plus `anthropic_beta` de-duplication semantics.

options.title: Add only a narrow beta option
options.body: Support a typed `anthropicBeta` or 1M-context option while avoiding arbitrary request-field passthrough.

options.title: Decline custom beta config
options.body: Keep beta flags internal and require first-class provider support for each Bedrock beta feature instead of letting user config send arbitrary vendor fields.

recommendation.title: Add Bedrock request-field merge contract
recommendation.body: Expose a Bedrock-owned, schema-validated merge point for vendor request fields and document precedence plus `anthropic_beta` de-duplication semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent Koc has the strongest available signal across recent provider/config work and prior routing of the Bedrock beta-field contract discussion.
